title: 🟠 लड्डू गिलहरी का गोल बिस्कुट लुढ़का... कोना हो तो लुढ़कता क्यों नहीं? #hindikids #gol
title_alts: 🟡 लड्डू गिलहरी और गोल आकार... बिना कोना गिने थाली गोल कैसे कहें? #hindikids #aakar
🔴 लड्डू गिलहरी का पहिया रुक गया... गोल न पहचानो तो कंचा भी अटकेगा #hindikids #gol
refrain: गोल गोल घूमा, यह गोल है!
description_hook: आज हम सिर्फ एक आकार सीखते हैं, गोल। थाली, सूरज और गेंद से पहचान पक्की हो जाएगी।

characters.name: लड्डू
characters.description: tiny two-year-old squirrel, fluffy reddish-brown fur with cream stripes on the back, wears a small green scarf, one round white patch above the nose

scenes.narration: आज हम एक आकार सीखेंगे। इसका नाम है गोल।
scenes.caption: Today we learn one shape. Its name is round.
scenes.image_brief: A large round steel plate lying flat on a wooden kitchen table in warm morning light, a tiny two-year-old squirrel with fluffy reddish-brown fur, cream stripes on its back, a small green scarf and a round white patch above its nose sitting beside the plate and patting its rim.

scenes.narration: गोल का कोई कोना नहीं होता। गोल, गोल, बिलकुल पहिये जैसा।
scenes.caption: Round has no corners at all. Round, round, just like a wheel.
scenes.image_brief: A single wooden cart wheel standing upright on a dusty village path in bright daylight, its smooth rim unbroken with no corners, the tiny two-year-old squirrel with fluffy reddish-brown fur, cream stripes, small green scarf and round white patch above the nose standing next to it and tracing the rim with one paw.

scenes.narration: रसोई में देखो, थाली गोल है। रोटी भी गोल बनती है, देखो।
scenes.caption: Look in the kitchen. The plate is round, and the roti is round too.
scenes.image_brief: A warm kitchen counter with one round steel plate holding two round rotis, a rolling pin resting beside them, soft yellow light from a window, the tiny two-year-old squirrel with fluffy reddish-brown fur, cream stripes, small green scarf and round white patch above the nose peeking over the counter edge at the rotis.

scenes.narration: अब मेरे साथ बोलो। तीन बार कहो, गोल, गोल, गोल।
scenes.caption: Now say it with me. Say it three times: round, round, round.
scenes.image_brief: Three round objects lined up on a bright green mat on the floor, a steel plate, an orange and a rubber ball, even soft daylight, the tiny two-year-old squirrel with fluffy reddish-brown fur, cream stripes, small green scarf and round white patch above the nose standing at the end of the row with both paws raised.

scenes.narration: शाबाश! गोल गोल घूमा, यह गोल है!
scenes.caption: Well done! Round and round it spins, this is round!
scenes.image_brief: A rubber ball spinning in place on a smooth stone floor with a faint blur around its edge, warm indoor light, the tiny two-year-old squirrel with fluffy reddish-brown fur, cream stripes, small green scarf and round white patch above the nose clapping its paws beside the spinning ball.

scenes.narration: अब आसमान देखो। सूरज गोल है, और चाँद भी गोल है।
scenes.caption: Now look at the sky. The sun is round, and the moon is round too.
scenes.image_brief: A clear evening sky split between a round setting sun on the left and a round pale moon on the right, a flat rooftop below with a low parapet, gentle orange and blue light, the tiny two-year-old squirrel with fluffy reddish-brown fur, cream stripes, small green scarf and round white patch above the nose sitting on the parapet looking up.

scenes.narration: खेल में भी गोल मिलेगा। गेंद गोल, और कंचा भी गोल।
scenes.caption: Round turns up in games too. The ball is round, the marble is round.
scenes.image_brief: A dusty playground patch with one red rubber ball and five glass marbles scattered near it, bright afternoon sunlight casting short shadows, the tiny two-year-old squirrel with fluffy reddish-brown fur, cream stripes, small green scarf and round white patch above the nose rolling one marble with its paw.

scenes.narration: बताओ, गोल कौन है, गेंद या डिब्बा? हाँ, गेंद गोल है।
scenes.caption: Tell me, which is round, the ball or the box? Yes, the ball is round.
scenes.image_brief: Two objects side by side on a plain wooden floor, a round red rubber ball on the left and a square cardboard box on the right, clear even daylight, the tiny two-year-old squirrel with fluffy reddish-brown fur, cream stripes, small green scarf and round white patch above the nose standing between them with a paw on the ball.

scenes.narration: थाली, सूरज, गेंद और कंचा, सब गोल। गोल गोल घूमा, यह गोल है!
scenes.caption: Plate, sun, ball and marble, all round. Round and round it spins, this is round!
scenes.image_brief: Four round things arranged in a circle on a bright yellow mat, a steel plate, a painted paper sun, a red ball and a glass marble, soft even light, the tiny two-year-old squirrel with fluffy reddish-brown fur, cream stripes, small green scarf and round white patch above the nose sitting happily in the middle.

title: 🟦 डिब्बू कछुआ की खिड़की टेढ़ी बनी... चार कोने न गिनो तो क्या होगा? #hindikids #chaukor
title_alts: 🟪 डिब्बू कछुआ और चौकोर आकार... बराबर भुजा भूले तो बिस्कुट बेढंगा बनेगा #hindikids #aakar
🟫 डिब्बू कछुआ की ईंट फिसल गई... चौकोर पहचानो, वरना दीवार टेढ़ी रहेगी #hindikids #chaukor
description_hook: एक ही आकार, चौकोर। खिड़की, ईंट और बिस्कुट से बच्चे चार कोने खुद गिनना सीख जाते हैं।

characters.name: डिब्बू
characters.description: three-year-old turtle, olive-green shell with neat square patches, wears a yellow cap, one small chip on the left edge of the shell

scenes.narration: आज एक नया आकार सीखते हैं, चौकोर।
scenes.caption: Today we learn a new shape: the square.
scenes.image_brief: A single square wooden window frame set in a whitewashed courtyard wall, morning light falling across it, a three-year-old turtle with an olive-green shell of neat square patches, a yellow cap and a small chip on the left edge of its shell standing below the window.

scenes.narration: चौकोर के चार कोने होते हैं। चारों भुजाएँ बराबर, यही चौकोर है।
scenes.caption: A square has four corners. All four sides are equal, that is a square.
scenes.image_brief: A flat square clay tile on a swept mud courtyard floor with its four corners clearly visible, warm daylight, the three-year-old turtle with olive-green shell of neat square patches, yellow cap and a small chip on the left shell edge touching one corner of the tile with its foot.

scenes.narration: खिड़की को देखो, वह चौकोर है। ईंट भी चौकोर होती है।
scenes.caption: Look at the window, it is square. A brick is square too.
scenes.image_brief: A square window in a mud-plastered wall with one red brick resting on the sill, bright midday light, the three-year-old turtle with olive-green shell of neat square patches, yellow cap and a small chip on the left shell edge looking up at the brick.

scenes.narration: मेरे साथ बोलो, चौकोर। अब कोने गिनो, एक, दो, तीन, चार।
scenes.caption: Say it with me: square. Now count the corners: one, two, three, four.
scenes.image_brief: A square red brick lying flat on a mud courtyard with four small white chalk dots marked on its corners, clear daylight, the three-year-old turtle with olive-green shell of neat square patches, yellow cap and a small chip on the left shell edge stepping around the brick.

scenes.narration: बहुत खूब। चार कोने, चार भुजा, चौकोर!
scenes.caption: Very good. Four corners, four sides, a square!
scenes.image_brief: A square chalk outline drawn on a mud courtyard floor with all four sides the same length, late afternoon light, the three-year-old turtle with olive-green shell of neat square patches, yellow cap and a small chip on the left shell edge standing inside the chalk square.

scenes.narration: खाने में भी चौकोर है। बिस्कुट चौकोर, और टोस्ट भी चौकोर।
scenes.caption: Squares show up in food too. The biscuit is square, the toast is square.
scenes.image_brief: A steel plate on a courtyard stool holding two square biscuits and one square slice of toast, soft morning light, the three-year-old turtle with olive-green shell of neat square patches, yellow cap and a small chip on the left shell edge reaching for a biscuit.

scenes.narration: चादर पर भी चौकोर छपे हैं। हर खाना चौकोर दिखता है।
scenes.caption: There are squares on the bedsheet too. Every check looks like a square.
scenes.image_brief: A cotton bedsheet spread on a courtyard cot printed with a grid of blue and white squares, bright daylight, the three-year-old turtle with olive-green shell of neat square patches, yellow cap and a small chip on the left shell edge sitting on one printed square.

scenes.narration: कौन चौकोर है, कैरम बोर्ड या गेंद? हाँ, कैरम बोर्ड चौकोर है।
scenes.caption: Which one is square, the carrom board or the ball? Yes, the carrom board.
scenes.image_brief: A square wooden carrom board propped against a courtyard wall on the left and a round yellow ball on the ground to the right, even daylight, the three-year-old turtle with olive-green shell of neat square patches, yellow cap and a small chip on the left shell edge between them touching the board.

scenes.narration: खिड़की, ईंट, बिस्कुट और कैरम बोर्ड, सब चौकोर। चार कोने, चार भुजा, चौकोर!
scenes.caption: Window, brick, biscuit and carrom board, all squares. Four corners, four sides, a square!
scenes.image_brief: Four square things laid out in a row on a mud courtyard floor, a small window frame, a red brick, a biscuit and a carrom board, warm evening light, the three-year-old turtle with olive-green shell of neat square patches, yellow cap and a small chip on the left shell edge standing at the end of the row.

title: 🔶 छुटकी चिड़िया का समोसा चपटा बना... तीन कोने न गिने तो क्या छूटा? #hindikids #trikon
title_alts: 🔺 छुटकी चिड़िया और त्रिकोण आकार... तीन कोने भूले तो टोपी टेढ़ी बनेगी #hindikids #aakar
🧡 छुटकी चिड़िया की टोपी खुल गई... त्रिकोण पहचानो, वरना समोसा गोल लगेगा #hindikids #trikon
description_hook: एक आकार, त्रिकोण। समोसा, पहाड़ और जन्मदिन की टोपी से तीन कोने गिनना आसान हो जाता है।

characters.name: छुटकी
characters.description: four-year-old sparrow, soft brown feathers with a cream chest, tiny orange beak, one white feather sticking up on her head

scenes.narration: आज हम त्रिकोण सीखेंगे। यह तीन कोनों वाला आकार है।
scenes.caption: Today we learn the triangle. It is the shape with three corners.
scenes.image_brief: A triangular paper cut-out lying on a sunlit rooftop terrace floor, its three corners clearly pointed, a four-year-old sparrow with soft brown feathers, a cream chest, a tiny orange beak and one white feather sticking up on her head standing beside it and tapping one corner with her beak.

scenes.narration: त्रिकोण की तीन भुजाएँ होती हैं। त्रिकोण, त्रिकोण, तीन कोने वाला।
scenes.caption: A triangle has three sides. Triangle, triangle, the one with three corners.
scenes.image_brief: Three thin bamboo sticks joined end to end into a triangle resting on a rooftop terrace ledge in bright morning light, a four-year-old sparrow with soft brown feathers, a cream chest, a tiny orange beak and one white feather sticking up on her head perched on the top corner of it.

scenes.narration: थाली में समोसा देखो। समोसा त्रिकोण है, तीनों कोने नुकीले हैं।
scenes.caption: Look at the samosa on the plate. It is a triangle with three sharp corners.
scenes.image_brief: One golden samosa on a small steel plate on a rooftop terrace ledge, its three pointed corners clearly visible, warm midday light, a four-year-old sparrow with soft brown feathers, a cream chest, a tiny orange beak and one white feather sticking up on her head hopping next to the plate.

scenes.narration: अब साथ बोलो, त्रिकोण। उँगली से तीन कोने छुओ।
scenes.caption: Now say it with me: triangle. Touch all three corners with your finger.
scenes.image_brief: A large triangle drawn in chalk on a rooftop terrace floor with a small pebble placed on each of its three corners, clear daylight, a four-year-old sparrow with soft brown feathers, a cream chest, a tiny orange beak and one white feather sticking up on her head standing at one pebble.

scenes.narration: वाह, बहुत अच्छा! तीन कोने गिनो, त्रिकोण मिला!
scenes.caption: Wonderful! Count three corners and you have found a triangle!
scenes.image_brief: The chalk triangle on the rooftop terrace floor now filled in with bright orange chalk, all three corners glowing in afternoon sun, a four-year-old sparrow with soft brown feathers, a cream chest, a tiny orange beak and one white feather sticking up on her head flapping her wings above it.

scenes.narration: अब बाहर पहाड़ देखो। उसकी चोटी त्रिकोण जैसी नुकीली लगती है।
scenes.caption: Now look at the hill outside. Its peak looks pointed, just like a triangle.
scenes.image_brief: A distant green hill with a sharply pointed peak seen beyond a rooftop terrace parapet, clear blue sky and soft morning light, a four-year-old sparrow with soft brown feathers, a cream chest, a tiny orange beak and one white feather sticking up on her head sitting on the parapet facing the hill.

scenes.narration: कपड़ों में भी त्रिकोण है। जन्मदिन की टोपी त्रिकोण होती है।
scenes.caption: Triangles appear in things we wear. A birthday cap is a triangle.
scenes.image_brief: A bright pink paper birthday cap standing upright on a rooftop terrace ledge, its triangular sides and pointed tip clear, warm light, a four-year-old sparrow with soft brown feathers, a cream chest, a tiny orange beak and one white feather sticking up on her head peeking out from behind it.

scenes.narration: सैंडविच को तिरछा काटो। देखो, दो त्रिकोण तैयार हो गए।
scenes.caption: Cut a sandwich corner to corner. Look, two triangles are ready.
scenes.image_brief: A sandwich cut diagonally into two triangular halves lying apart on a wooden board on a rooftop terrace, soft daylight, a four-year-old sparrow with soft brown feathers, a cream chest, a tiny orange beak and one white feather sticking up on her head standing between the two halves.

scenes.narration: बताओ, कौन त्रिकोण है, समोसा या रोटी? हाँ, समोसा त्रिकोण है।
scenes.caption: Tell me, which is a triangle, the samosa or the roti? Yes, the samosa.
scenes.image_brief: A samosa on the left and a round roti on the right, both on a single steel plate on a rooftop terrace floor, even daylight, a four-year-old sparrow with soft brown feathers, a cream chest, a tiny orange beak and one white feather sticking up on her head standing beside the samosa.

scenes.narration: समोसा, पहाड़, टोपी और सैंडविच, सब त्रिकोण। तीन कोने गिनो, त्रिकोण मिला!
scenes.caption: Samosa, hill, cap and sandwich, all triangles. Count three corners, you found a triangle!
scenes.image_brief: Four triangular things laid out in a row on a rooftop terrace floor, a samosa, a paper hill cut-out, a pink birthday cap and a sandwich half, warm evening light, a four-year-old sparrow with soft brown feathers, a cream chest, a tiny orange beak and one white feather sticking up on her head standing at the end of the row.

title: 🧸 भोलू भालू की टोकरी उलट गई... लाल न पहचानो तो टमाटर कैसे छाँटो? #hindikids #laal
title_alts: ❤️ भोलू भालू और लाल रंग... लाल भूले तो गुलाब और दूध एक से लगेंगे #hindikids #rang
🌹 भोलू भालू का लाल गुब्बारा उड़ा... रंग पहचानो, वरना टोकरी में सब मिलेगा #hindikids #laal
description_hook: आज एक ही रंग, लाल। टमाटर, गुलाब और गुब्बारे से बच्चे लाल तुरंत छाँटने लगते हैं।

characters.name: भोलू
characters.description: five-year-old bear cub, chubby, dark brown fur with a cream muzzle, wears a red striped vest, small bell on his collar

scenes.narration: आज हम एक रंग सीखेंगे। इस रंग का नाम लाल है।
scenes.caption: Today we learn one colour. The name of this colour is red.
scenes.image_brief: A single ripe red tomato sitting alone on a pale wooden kitchen counter in soft morning light, a chubby five-year-old bear cub with dark brown fur, a cream muzzle, wearing a red striped vest and a small bell on his collar standing beside the counter looking at the tomato.

scenes.narration: लाल बहुत चमकीला रंग है। लाल, लाल, जैसे पका टमाटर।
scenes.caption: Red is a very bright colour. Red, red, like a ripe tomato.
scenes.image_brief: A close arrangement of three ripe red tomatoes on a white cloth on a kitchen counter, bright daylight making their skins shine, a chubby five-year-old bear cub with dark brown fur, a cream muzzle, wearing a red striped vest and a small bell on his collar resting one paw next to them.

scenes.narration: रसोई की टोकरी देखो। उसमें दो टमाटर लाल हैं।
scenes.caption: Look at the basket in the kitchen. Two tomatoes in it are red.
scenes.image_brief: A cane basket on a kitchen floor holding two red tomatoes among green vegetables, warm light from a window, a chubby five-year-old bear cub with dark brown fur, a cream muzzle, wearing a red striped vest and a small bell on his collar crouching at the basket and lifting one tomato.

scenes.narration: अब मेरे साथ बोलो, लाल। जो लाल दिखे, छुओ।
scenes.caption: Now say it with me: red. Touch whatever looks red.
scenes.image_brief: Four objects in a row on a kitchen floor mat, a red tomato, a red balloon, a green cucumber and a white cup, even daylight, a chubby five-year-old bear cub with dark brown fur, a cream muzzle, wearing a red striped vest and a small bell on his collar reaching towards the red balloon.

scenes.narration: शाबाश! लाल दिखा, लाल बोलो, लाल!
scenes.caption: Well done! See red, say red, red!
scenes.image_brief: A red balloon and a red tomato placed together on a bright white kitchen floor tile, strong clear daylight, a chubby five-year-old bear cub with dark brown fur, a cream muzzle, wearing a red striped vest and a small bell on his collar clapping his paws beside them with his collar bell swinging.

scenes.narration: बगीचे में गुलाब लाल है। गुब्बारा भी लाल हो सकता है।
scenes.caption: The rose in the garden is red. A balloon can be red too.
scenes.image_brief: A single red rose blooming on a bush in a small garden with a red balloon tied to the fence behind it, gentle morning light, a chubby five-year-old bear cub with dark brown fur, a cream muzzle, wearing a red striped vest and a small bell on his collar sniffing the rose.

scenes.narration: कपड़ों में भी लाल दिखता है। लाल दुपट्टा धूप में खूब चमकता है।
scenes.caption: Red shows up in clothes as well. A red scarf shines bright in the sun.
scenes.image_brief: A red cotton scarf hanging on a garden clothesline and lifting slightly in the breeze, bright sunlight behind it, a chubby five-year-old bear cub with dark brown fur, a cream muzzle, wearing a red striped vest and a small bell on his collar standing under it looking up.

scenes.narration: बताओ, कौन लाल है, तरबूज़ का गूदा या दूध? हाँ, गूदा लाल है।
scenes.caption: Tell me, which is red, the watermelon flesh or the milk? Yes, the flesh.
scenes.image_brief: A cut watermelon slice showing bright red flesh on the left and a glass of white milk on the right, both on a garden table, clear daylight, a chubby five-year-old bear cub with dark brown fur, a cream muzzle, wearing a red striped vest and a small bell on his collar pointing a paw at the watermelon.

scenes.narration: टमाटर, गुलाब, गुब्बारा और तरबूज़, सब लाल। लाल दिखा, लाल बोलो, लाल!
scenes.caption: Tomato, rose, balloon and watermelon, all red. See red, say red, red!
scenes.image_brief: Four red things grouped on a garden table, a tomato, a rose, a balloon and a watermelon slice, warm late afternoon light, a chubby five-year-old bear cub with dark brown fur, a cream muzzle, wearing a red striped vest and a small bell on his collar sitting behind the table with his paws on the edge.

title: 😃 चमकी मुर्गी का पीला दाना बिखर गया... पीला न पहचानो तो क्या छूटेगा? #hindikids #peela
title_alts: 🌞 चमकी मुर्गी और पीला रंग... पीला भूले तो नींबू और बैंगन एक से लगेंगे #hindikids #rang
🐓 चमकी मुर्गी की पीली बस निकल गई... रंग जानो, वरना पका केला भी छूटेगा #hindikids #peela
description_hook: आज सिर्फ पीला रंग। केला, गेंदा और स्कूल बस देखकर बच्चे पीला झट से पहचान लेते हैं।

characters.name: चमकी
characters.description: three-year-old hen, plump, creamy white feathers, bright red comb, yellow ribbon tied round her neck

scenes.narration: आज हम पीला रंग सीखेंगे। यह धूप जैसा चमकीला रंग है।
scenes.caption: Today we learn the colour yellow. It is as bright as sunshine.
scenes.image_brief: A single ripe yellow banana lying on a flat stone in a sunlit farmyard, strong midday light making the peel glow, a plump three-year-old hen with creamy white feathers, a bright red comb and a yellow ribbon tied round her neck standing beside it.

scenes.narration: पीला हल्का और चमकीला होता है। पीला, पीला, जैसे पका मीठा केला।
scenes.caption: Yellow is light and bright. Yellow, yellow, like a sweet ripe banana.
scenes.image_brief: Three ripe yellow bananas hanging from a stalk in a farmyard corner, warm sunlight falling on them from the side, a plump three-year-old hen with creamy white feathers, a bright red comb and a yellow ribbon tied round her neck pecking gently near the lowest banana.

scenes.narration: रसोई की टोकरी में केला देखो। उसका छिलका पूरा पीला दिखता है।
scenes.caption: Look at the banana in the kitchen basket. Its whole peel looks yellow.
scenes.image_brief: A cane basket on a kitchen shelf holding two yellow bananas beside a green gourd, soft light from a nearby window, a plump three-year-old hen with creamy white feathers, a bright red comb and a yellow ribbon tied round her neck perched on the shelf edge looking into the basket.

scenes.narration: अब मेरे साथ ज़ोर से बोलो, पीला। दो बार कहो, पीला, पीला।
scenes.caption: Now say it loudly with me: yellow. Say it twice: yellow, yellow.
scenes.image_brief: Four objects placed in a row on a farmyard bench, a yellow banana, a yellow marigold, a green chilli and a white egg, clear daylight, a plump three-year-old hen with creamy white feathers, a bright red comb and a yellow ribbon tied round her neck standing at the banana end of the row.

scenes.narration: शाबाश! पीला चमका, बोलो पीला! फिर से बोलो।
scenes.caption: Well done! Yellow is shining, say yellow! Say it again.
scenes.image_brief: A bunch of bright yellow marigold flowers heaped in a shallow steel tray on a farmyard floor, strong afternoon sun on the petals, a plump three-year-old hen with creamy white feathers, a bright red comb and a yellow ribbon tied round her neck flapping her wings beside the tray.

scenes.narration: बगीचे में गेंदा फूल पीला है। और स्कूल बस भी पीली होती है।
scenes.caption: The marigold in the garden is yellow. A school bus is yellow too.
scenes.image_brief: A yellow marigold plant flowering at the edge of a garden with a yellow school bus parked on the road just beyond the low wall, bright morning light, a plump three-year-old hen with creamy white feathers, a bright red comb and a yellow ribbon tied round her neck standing between the flowers.

scenes.narration: बताओ, कौन पीला है, नींबू या बैंगन? हाँ, नींबू पीला है, बैंगन नहीं।
scenes.caption: Tell me, which is yellow, the lemon or the brinjal? Yes, the lemon is yellow.
scenes.image_brief: A yellow lemon on the left and a deep purple brinjal on the right, both resting on a wooden farmyard table, even daylight, a plump three-year-old hen with creamy white feathers, a bright red comb and a yellow ribbon tied round her neck pecking lightly at the lemon.

scenes.narration: केला, गेंदा, स्कूल बस और नींबू, सब पीले हैं। पीला चमका, बोलो पीला!
scenes.caption: Banana, marigold, school bus and lemon, all yellow. Yellow is shining, say yellow!
scenes.image_brief: Four yellow things grouped on a wooden farmyard table, a banana, a marigold flower, a toy school bus and a lemon, warm late afternoon light, a plump three-year-old hen with creamy white feathers, a bright red comb and a yellow ribbon tied round her neck standing behind them.

title: 😌 झिलमिल मछली का तालाब धुँधला हुआ... नीला न पहचानो तो कैसे बताओ? #hindikids #neela
title_alts: 🐟 झिलमिल मछली और नीला रंग... नीला भूले तो जामुन और मोर पंख अलग लगेंगे #hindikids #rang
🌊 झिलमिल मछली की नीली बाल्टी खाली... रंग पहचानो, वरना पानी सादा लगेगा #hindikids #neela
description_hook: एक ही रंग, नीला। आसमान, तालाब और जामुन से बच्चे नीला हर जगह पहचानना सीख जाते हैं।

characters.name: झिलमिल
characters.description: four-year-old fish, small, silvery blue scales, wide fan-shaped tail, one dark spot near her gill

scenes.narration: आज हम नीला रंग सीखेंगे। नीला हमें हर दिन दिखता है।
scenes.caption: Today we learn the colour blue. We see blue every single day.
scenes.image_brief: A calm village pond under a wide clear blue sky at midday, the water surface reflecting the sky, a small four-year-old fish with silvery blue scales, a wide fan-shaped tail and one dark spot near her gill swimming just below the surface near the bank.

scenes.narration: नीला ठंडा और शांत रंग है। नीला, नीला, जैसे खुला आसमान।
scenes.caption: Blue is a cool, calm colour. Blue, blue, like the open sky.
scenes.image_brief: A wide expanse of cloudless blue sky above a pond with two reeds standing at the edge, soft midday light, a small four-year-old fish with silvery blue scales, a wide fan-shaped tail and one dark spot near her gill poking her head above the water and looking up.

scenes.narration: ऊपर आसमान देखो। दिन में पूरा आसमान नीला नीला दिखता है।
scenes.caption: Look up at the sky. All day long the whole sky looks blue.
scenes.image_brief: The blue sky seen from the middle of a pond with the water and sky meeting at a far bank, bright even daylight, a small four-year-old fish with silvery blue scales, a wide fan-shaped tail and one dark spot near her gill floating still on the surface.

scenes.narration: अब मेरे साथ बोलो, नीला। कमरे में जो नीला दिखे, उसे दिखाओ।
scenes.caption: Now say it with me: blue. Point to anything blue in your room.
scenes.image_brief: Four objects lined up on a stone slab at the pond edge, a blue plastic bucket, a blue glass bead, a brown pot and a green leaf, clear daylight, a small four-year-old fish with silvery blue scales, a wide fan-shaped tail and one dark spot near her gill swimming in the shallow water beside the slab.

scenes.narration: बहुत अच्छा! नीला ऊपर, नीला नीचे, नीला!
scenes.caption: Very good! Blue above, blue below, blue!
scenes.image_brief: A pond scene split evenly between blue sky above and blue reflecting water below, soft light on the water ripples, a small four-year-old fish with silvery blue scales, a wide fan-shaped tail and one dark spot near her gill leaping just above the surface in the middle.

scenes.narration: अब तालाब का पानी देखो। हिलता पानी भी नीला लगता है।
scenes.caption: Now look at the pond water. Even the moving water looks blue.
scenes.image_brief: Close view of gently rippling pond water with a blue tint and small circles spreading across it, warm afternoon light, a small four-year-old fish with silvery blue scales, a wide fan-shaped tail and one dark spot near her gill swimming through the ripples.

scenes.narration: खाने में भी नीला है। पके जामुन गहरे नीले दिखते हैं।
scenes.caption: Blue is in food as well. Ripe jamun fruits look deep blue.
scenes.image_brief: A small heap of ripe deep blue jamun fruits on a banana leaf placed on a rock at the pond edge, dappled shade and sunlight, a small four-year-old fish with silvery blue scales, a wide fan-shaped tail and one dark spot near her gill peeping out of the water near the rock.

scenes.narration: घर में नीली बाल्टी रखी है। मोर का पंख भी नीला है।
scenes.caption: There is a blue bucket at home. A peacock feather is blue too.
scenes.image_brief: A blue plastic bucket standing on a courtyard step with a single peacock feather resting against it, soft morning light, a small four-year-old fish with silvery blue scales, a wide fan-shaped tail and one dark spot near her gill visible in a glass bowl of water beside the bucket.

scenes.narration: बताओ, कौन नीला है, आसमान या केला? हाँ, आसमान नीला है।
scenes.caption: Tell me, which is blue, the sky or the banana? Yes, the sky is blue.
scenes.image_brief: A wide blue sky above a pond on the left of the frame and a yellow banana resting on the stone bank on the right, clear daylight, a small four-year-old fish with silvery blue scales, a wide fan-shaped tail and one dark spot near her gill swimming near the bank.

scenes.narration: आसमान, पानी, जामुन और मोर पंख, सब नीले। नीला ऊपर, नीला नीचे, नीला!
scenes.caption: Sky, water, jamun and peacock feather, all blue. Blue above, blue below, blue!
scenes.image_brief: Four blue things arranged at a pond edge, a patch of open sky reflected in a puddle, a bowl of pond water, a heap of jamun and a peacock feather, warm evening light, a small four-year-old fish with silvery blue scales, a wide fan-shaped tail and one dark spot near her gill swimming in the puddle.
